entry.title: Undertow 1.5.0
entry.summary: Altered delay with Analogue, Tape, Lo-Fi and Reverse modes, degrading repeats, runaway feedback and tempo sync. For MPC OS 3.10.1+ (Akai Force, MPC Live/One/X/Key, MPC XL, Live III). **Install** 1. Preferences > Enhancements (Beta): turn on Enable Enhancements and External Plugin Support. 2. Unzip, copy `Fullban - VST - Undertow` into `VST2 Plugins` at the top of a drive (internal, SD card or USB). 3. Restart MPC (a USB drive can just be re-plugged). entry.title: Undertow 1.0.0
entry.summary: Altered delay with Analogue, Tape, Lo-Fi and Reverse modes, degrading repeats, runaway feedback and tempo sync. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force.
